title: Insider Trading Policy

tiers.name: All Officers and Employees
tiers.description: Officers and employees of SKY generally; may not buy or sell SKY securities, or disclose Material Information to others with a view to them trading, while an Information Insider. Not subject to Prohibited Periods unless also Key Management Personnel.

tiers.name: Directors and Officers
tiers.description: Directors and 'Officers' (persons who report, directly or through no more than two intervening levels, to the Board, or who manage a principal business unit, division or function) as defined by the Securities Markets Act 1988 and Regulations. Must disclose Relevant Interests and dealings to SKY and NZX within 5 trading days, continuing for 6 months after ceasing to hold the role.

tiers.name: Key Management Personnel
tiers.description: The Board of Directors, Officers (as defined above), and anyone else notified by SKY's Company Secretary as Key Management Personnel. Prohibited from trading SKY securities during Prohibited Periods (subject to exclusions and exceptional-circumstances consent) whether or not they are Information Insiders, and responsible for the trading of companies and trusts they control.

tiers.name: Controlled Companies and Trusts
tiers.description: Companies or trusts that Key Management Personnel control (broadly interpreted as the ability to influence the entity's decisions) or in which they have a beneficial interest; their trading in SKY securities is treated as the Key Management Personnel member's own for Prohibited Period purposes.

windows.start_anchor: 30 days prior to SKY's half year balance date
windows.end_anchor: first trading day after the half year results are released to NZX

windows.start_anchor: 30 days prior to SKY's year end balance date
windows.end_anchor: first trading day after the full year results are released to NZX

windows.start_anchor: 30 days prior to the release of a prospectus for a general public offer of SKY securities

rules.detail: Derivatives are not named and the trading prohibition is expressed only as 'buy or sell securities'; there is no agreement-to-deal or financial-product catch-all that would sweep in an OTC put/call.
Hedging, and unvested incentive-plan securities, are not mentioned anywhere in this chapter.
Monetisation is not named, and the policy's 'trading' concept is limited to buying or selling securities with no agreement-to-deal catch-all to sweep in a prepaid forward or similar arrangement.
Short selling is not named anywhere in the policy.
Securities lending is not named anywhere in the policy.
CFDs are not named and are not caught by the narrow 'buy or sell securities' trading concept.

Margin lending is named only as an example of a secured financing arrangement; entering into one is not itself restricted, and a forced sale by the secured lender enforcing its rights is expressly excluded from the Prohibited Period trading ban, so it will not breach the policy even during a closed period.
rules.evidence: disposal of SKY securities due to a secured lender exercising their rights, for example under a margin lending arrangement

rules.detail: Granting a security interest, charge, lien or pledge over SKY securities is not itself addressed; only a secured lender's later enforcement sale is referenced (see margin_lending/secured_financing).

'for example' signals margin lending is only an illustration of secured financing generally; a secured lender's forced sale on enforcement of its rights is expressly excluded from the Prohibited Period ban, not limited to margin loans, and entering the arrangement itself is not otherwise restricted.
rules.evidence: disposal of SKY securities due to a secured lender exercising their rights, for example under a margin lending arrangement

rules.detail: There is no short-term or speculative dealing restriction anywhere in this chapter.

clearance.evidence: The person notifies SKY's Company Secretary in writing of their intention to trade ... SKY's Company Secretary will promptly consider the request and determine whether consent will be given in his/her absolute discretion. Any consent to trade given by the Sky's Company Secretary will be deemed to be withdrawn if the relevant Key Management Personnel becomes aware of Material Information prior to trading.

clearance.post_trade_to: Chief Financial Officer (for SKY's interests register) and NZX
clearance.post_trade_deadline: within 5 trading days of appointment or the relevant transaction
clearance.evidence: The Act also requires directors and officers of SKY to disclose Relevant Interests and dealings in securities of the public issuer and any related body corporate to the public issuer and NZX within 5 trading days of their appointment or the relevant transaction.

exceptions.evidence: participation in an employee, executive or director incentive plan operated by SKY

acquisition of SKY securities through a dividend reinvestment plan; ... acquisition of SKY securities through a share purchase plan available to all retail shareholders; ... acquisition of SKY securities through a rights issue
disposal of SKY securities through the acceptance of a takeover offer

dealings that result in no effective change to the beneficial interest in the securities (for example, a transfer of shares held by an Officer into a superannuation fund or trust of which that Officer is the beneficiary)

trading under a pre-approved non-discretionary trading plan where: the plan was not entered into or amended during a Prohibited Period, the plan does not permit the person to exercise any influence or discretion in relation trading under the plan; and the plan is for a fixed period and cannot be cancelled before the expiry of that period, other than in exceptional circumstances
disposal of SKY securities due to a secured lender exercising their rights, for example under a margin lending arrangement
other circumstances that are deemed to be exceptional

exemption_authority: SKY's Company Secretary may permit trading during a Prohibited Period in exceptional circumstances (severe financial hardship, compulsion by court order, or other circumstances deemed exceptional), exercised in his/her absolute discretion after the person confirms in writing they hold no Material Information; any consent is deemed withdrawn if Material Information arises before the trade.

bespoke_clauses.clause: disposal of SKY securities due to a secured lender exercising their rights, for example under a margin lending arrangement
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: This expressly protects a bank's enforcement sale of collared shares even during a Prohibited Period, which is unusually favourable for a funded collar's lender compared to most policies that treat forced sales as a breach.

bespoke_clauses.topic: no hedging or secured financing prohibition
bespoke_clauses.clause: 17.1.1: officers and employees of the company may not buy or sell securities in the company while they are Information Insiders
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The policy's only general restriction on 'dealing' is buying or selling while an insider; nothing in the chapter prohibits granting security over shares or entering hedging/derivative arrangements, so the collar's equity and loan legs face no express bar outside Prohibited Periods.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Control should be given a broad meaning, and you will be considered to control an entity if you can influence decisions made by that entity.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Structuring the collar through a family trust or holding company controlled by the executive does not escape the Prohibited Period restriction, since the entity's trading is attributed to the Key Management Personnel member.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Any consent to trade given by the Sky's Company Secretary will be deemed to be withdrawn if the relevant Key Management Personnel becomes aware of Material Information prior to trading.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A cleared collar entered into during a Prohibited Period on exceptional-circumstances consent could become unexecutable if Material Information arises before signing.

bespoke_clauses.clause: A person is treated as a director or Officer for a period of 6 months after the date on which they cease to be a director or Officer, and must continue to comply with these disclosure obligations.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Relevant Interest disclosure duties (including any interest created or discharged by the collar) continue for 6 months after the executive leaves the role.

summary: This 2011 insider-trading chapter from SKY Network Television's staff manual (an NZX-primary, ASX-listed issuer) never mentions derivatives, hedging, CFDs, stock lending or short selling, so an OTC put/call over SKY shares is unrestricted by name and is governed only by the general prohibition on trading while an Information Insider. Key Management Personnel (Board, Officers, and anyone else so notified) may not trade during 30-day pre-results/pre-prospectus Prohibited Periods unless SKY's Company Secretary grants exceptional-circumstances consent (hardship, court order, or other, at the Secretary's absolute discretion, and deemed withdrawn if Material Information later arises). Critically, section 17.6.5(k) expressly excludes a secured lender's enforcement sale, 'for example under a margin lending arrangement', from the Prohibited Period ban, and nothing in the chapter restricts granting security over the shares or entering a secured financing arrangement, so a bank-secured collar loan and its enforcement rights appear well-protected even during closed periods. The policy is silent on unvested shares as collateral, general forced-sale mechanics, financing disclosure, and any minimum shareholding requirement. Overall a funded collar looks achievable for Key Management Personnel outside Prohibited Periods (or with Company Secretary consent), with the secured lender's enforcement position unusually well protected, though the bank should not assume any structured clearance regime exists for the derivative legs themselves.
